title: Omnichannel banking architecture and experience boundaries
workflow: Define channel personas, device types and institution-specific offerings
Authenticate via approved identity provider and scoped token audience
Resolve per-account capabilities, mandates and KYC state at backend
Fetch read-only balances with snapshot freshness from authoritative APIs
Route state-changing requests through validated banking commands
Handle failure, retry, pending and unknown outcomes transparently
invariants: No banking channel stores or mutates authoritative ledger balances
Client-side role visibility is not server-side authorization
API may not promote read projection to final settlement authority
Institution feature availability is effective dated and reviewed
Channel supports localized currency, language and accessible errors
Cross-channel idempotency prevents repeated financial consequences
Session and personal-data handling comply with approved institution policy
acceptance_tests: Unauthorized UI route cannot reach protected API
Mobile and web retry same command without duplication
Read projection shows stale status explicitly
independent_gate: Approved institution/channel profile, identity policy, backend API contracts and usability/security review.
